episodes.title: The Dangerous Cults Behind AI Believe Humans Can Be Replaced | Timnit Gebru
episodes.description:
In this clip, former co-lead of Google’s Ethical AI team and leading AI researcher Dr Timnit Gebru   examines the beliefs driving Silicon Valley’s race to build a “machine god.” She argues that warnings about AI destroying humanity serve as marketing, distract from present harms and help powerful companies escape accountability. Myriam François questions why insiders leaving these companies raise similar alarms. For Gebru, the crucial question is who benefits when we fear the technology rather than scrutinise the people building it.
